A18's census rules, logged before the census script is written (G50's order test): each ruled line takes its class from the spec files and the absent rulings, checked against the decision and kind in the rulings files. Order lines are O-A and S-O-A (answered in the thread), O-H and S-O-H (by the hours or in a post's own words), absent rejects (ungraded) and NONPORTABLE particulars marked PO. The bound's pattern is BOUND and S-BOUND, with PRE where a rival from outside the canvas is named. Counted apart: one act or unplaceable hours (J, EL-J); not the room's attack (NA, EL-NA); a taunt after an attack the room suffers (SUF, EL-SUF); a visitor's call answered by taunts (V, EL-V); not a taunt (NT, EL-NT); one end or neither (ONE, EL-ONE); the first attack after the close (AFTER, EL-AFTER); other particulars; absent specifications; evidence limits. By room: an episode room shows the order or the bound in some line; the order's share is order rooms over episode rooms, and again with one-act rooms added to the denominator; bound-only rooms are listed with their PRE marks. Over the order lines that carry tags (instantiate, restrict and add lines; absent rejects are not graded): the form of the first taunt (TAUNT, VICT, SALUTE, FLOOD, BLAME), the rival (SAME, ELSE), taunts after the close (AC) and ends from a coded post above (R), by line and by room. Rooms whose only episode-like line is a taunt after an attack suffered (SUF with no order or bound) are counted, for the mechanism's named party. Printed with their classes: the support-transition rooms (rpi, anarcho_capitalism, clg), C2's sampled rooms (reddevils, nbaspurs, cardinals, portugal) and A18's subs (unitedkingdom, rpi, anarcho_capitalism, clg). The return's lines are not a census of every room, so the shares are reported beside C2's and not in place of them.
